Game Overview

At its heart, Motocross Zombie is a sports game about outrace zombies on your motorcycle in Motocross Zombie, combining white-knuckle speed with breathtaking stunts. Immersed in a chilling atmosphere, skillfully maneuver and accelerate to escape relentless undead pursuers. Master mid-air rotations and seek power-ups to survive this high-adrenaline, post-apocalyptic adventure.

Getting started in Motocross Zombie doesn't take long to learn. Outrace zombies on your motorcycle in Motocross Zombie, combining white-knuckle speed with breathtaking stunts.
